reason: A DSH prompt and context management plugin that configures multi-layer prompt injection, agent and model behavior, tool filtering, and preset editing through a web UI.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 的多个注入层配置提示词、代理与工具行为，并通过 Web UI 编辑和导入预设。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin for configuring multi-layer prompt injection, agent and tool behavior, and editing or importing presets through a web UI.

capabilities: Configures and injects prompts across six DSH-supported execution layers
Modifies agent request and LLM stream handling according to preset configuration
Applies configurable tool-pipeline filtering and allow, deny, ask, accept, replace, or block behaviors
Provides a web UI for editing prompt configurations and presets
Imports SillyTavern JSON presets into local prompt and model configurations
